steps.speaker: Corpus
steps.content: Ahhh... This again... This again... Those despicable shackles... That despicable f****...!

steps.speaker: Corpus
steps.content: I won't die at your hands for a second time! I'll never... ah!!!
Red light pierces out from the ground, penetrating and binding its limbs as it tries to escape. The weakened monster turns its head to look at its tiny enemy in resentment and fear.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I'm tired of playing hide-and-seek with you.

steps.speaker: Corpus
steps.content: ...Ha... Haha, you want to devour me?

steps.speaker: Corpus
steps.content: Do you dare to use your shackles? You don't! You're totally different. Yours is defective, and not only that, it's also bound and constrained!

steps.speaker: Corpus
steps.content: If you try to devour me with it, you'll get torn apart, too! You'll also... Ahhhh!!!

The blue light reappears and pierces your consciousness the same moment you pierce the Corpus' core. It saps your strength, and you feel as if you're getting torn asunder. This blue light truly strikes fear into your heart.

Where did it come from? The enemy's body? Is it there to protect its core and block your attack? Or does it come from some unknown corner, and belong to some consciousness beyond your control that's countering your actions?
The bone-chilling cold of the blue shackles leaves you no time to think any further. That monster is still struggling and trying to escape, but you're equally persistent...

steps.speaker: Corpus
steps.content: Aaaahhh...!! Why... what did you do to me??

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Hehe... Yes, I don't want to die yet... So... I won't devour you...

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: But I also don't want you to escape... So I did a little experiment...

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: You were the first Corpseborne I cast my shackles upon... I didn't make too deep of a mark, but just enough to find you. From now on, we are one. I'll be able to find you wherever you go.

steps.speaker: Corpus
steps.content: D-don't think you can get out of this alive!
It waves with all its strength, hitting you with gusts of wind. Pierced by the blue light, you're powerless to fight against it, and get blown aside like a piece of paper. You finally let go.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Okay... You can go now... Flee as hard as you can... I can't do anything about it...

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: But in the future, those humans you regard as food will come to deal with you.

Your vision becomes a red blur. Your mind is blacking out, but you can feel it escaping from the other side of the shackles. That weak monster has been brought completely under control, and won't be hard to suppress.

steps.speaker: Corpus
steps.content: That woman will kill you! She'll kill all of you! She's here already!

steps.speaker: Corpus
steps.content: That arrogant devil... When it becomes chaotic, tyrannical, mad, and unrestrained on the surface, she'll come... to finish the reaping, as she always has...
Your mind gradually slackens and relaxes. Wouldn't it be bad if chaos continues to plague West District? Even though your energy is limited, shouldn't you still do something?

After all, Mania and Black Rings are simply endpoints. What a strange city. What a strange era. Disasters seem to all stem from people's hearts. The ills that people want to ignore all eventually erupt into monsters.

steps.speaker: Stumbling Contaminated Creature
steps.content: Grrr... Grrrr... I'll kill you... kill...
Sigh... it still has some tricks up its sleeve for you. What are you going to do? Pierced by the blue shackles, you have no more strength to fight.
And to think you were trying to look tough in front of Hecate and others just now. Now that you're actually on your own, you're really struggling.

steps.speaker: Stumbling Contaminated Creature
steps.content: ...Kill you!! Grrr!!
A sharp wire glowing blue cuts through the monster's gel, making it fall in a heap on the ground. A hand yanks you away from the contamination.

steps.speaker: Taran
steps.content: Huff... Huff... Come with me...

<size=31>Seeing that you're unable to stand, he quickly treats your wounds, and hoists you up with his shoulders. The youth is riddled with wounds. His eyes are bloodshot, and his whole body is quivering uncontrollably. There's blood on his face, which didn't look like his own.</size>

A lot of contamination monsters are approaching. He pelts them with gunfire with one hand. When he runs out of bullets, he tosses the empty gun aside and quickly draws another. You notice he's carrying an unusually large amount of weapons.

steps.speaker: Taran
steps.content: I'm taking you back... You can't die here. I can't let them take you away... Even if I'm the last one standing, I will... take you back...

He doesn't answer your question, and just keeps muttering the same few words over and over again in a trembling voice. He no longer seemed like a battle-hardened Rustfire combatant, but a frightened child left behind on the battlefield.
He staggers and almost falls, but continues to drag you along with stubborn fervor.

steps.speaker: Choice
options: Don't worry, kid. It's okay now.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I found that monster. We hold the initiative now.
You raise your hands to cast the shackles on him, but realize you don't have the strength to summon them.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: There's no need to sacrifice so many people. You guys can find a way out. You have time. You don't need to fight so desperately anymore...

steps.speaker: Taran
steps.content: No... They won't give up... That thing has no humanity. It doesn't care about human life... It's not human at all...

steps.speaker: Taran
steps.content: Both eight years ago and now... Its target has always been... Rustfire... No...

steps.speaker: Taran
steps.content: No... All of us... All of Syndicate... It slaughtered us however it liked... That bastard... That bastard...

steps.speaker: Taran
steps.content: It's got its eyes on you. You'll get used, too. It'll use you to destroy everything... You have to go... You must not... fall into their hands...

steps.speaker: Taran
steps.content: I'll... take you away...
You still want a clear answer, but in barges a sudden rumble of footsteps. Taran roars, and gunshots ring out. Soon, both of you get knocked to the ground. You hit your head and lose your vision.
Someone grabs you and drags you along the ground for a distance. Taran's hysterical screams ring in your ears, but you can't make out what he's saying.
Hush wants this one.
Clean everything else up.
Finish the job... quickly...
Bang—you hear someone falling to the ground.
Bang—you hear another person falling to the ground. The footsteps around you become chaotic.

Someone grabs you by the neck and starts pulling you back in panic. Chaotic gunfire erupts all around you. You hear a bloodcurdling roar riddled with anger, despair, and mad persistence, emanating Sinner-like power. Then...
The last thing you remember is something striking you.
DisSea
The black raven on the boat goes into a fit. At the same time, both Hella and Hecate suddenly collapse, as if drained of all energy. Crache looks at them in confusion.

steps.speaker: Crache
steps.content: What's wrong?

steps.speaker: Black Raven
steps.content: Turn around... Turn around... Leave... Leave now...
There's commotion coming from the direction of Inner Bay Shelter. Crache instinctively stops the boat, and looks into the distance vigilantly.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Ow... My head hurts...

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: ...The shackles feel different... What is this...

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Chief... Chief is still alive, but...
